integrity: The proof is analytic; exact symbolic and high-precision numerical checks are supportive only. No independent scientific audit, external certification or author attribution is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The universal cubic coefficient is proved for one natural collective geodesic at each two-supported normal. It does not classify global section-volume maximizers, arbitrary multivariate third-order perturbations, or uniform large-dimensional remainders. Earlier work supplies the quadratic Hessian. Historical literature incompleteness remains a priority risk.
title: A universal cubic cusp at sparse restricted cross-polytope sections
